text:
The plate is about 20-22 cm across (it spans roughly 350 px in the image). It holds a pile of green-wrapped dumplings, probably 5-6 pieces, with chili oil and herbs on top.

Each dumpling probably weighs 25-30 g, so 6 pieces come to about 165 g. Adding around 15 g of sauce and oil gives roughly 180 g in total.

Vegetable dumplings run about 1.5-2 kcal/g. Including the oil, I estimate about 1.6 kcal/g, which gives roughly 290 kcal.

{"kcal": 290, "mass_g": 180}
